remarks: Stylish and spacious, recently renovated 1BR/1.5BA loft in a desirable South Norwalk location, yet tucked back on a quiet street. Originally a button factory in the early 1900s, this nearly 1,000 sq ft home blends historic charm with modern updates, featuring soaring lofted ceilings, double-height windows, and an open-concept layout. The sleek brand new kitchen showcases quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar that opens to the airy living space. The first floor also offers multiple storage closets and a tastefully renovated powder room. Upstairs features a large, versatile lofted bedroom with plush carpet, custom closet, and an updated full bath. Enjoy secure entry, a private storage space, reserved parking spot "X," plus guest parking. Pet-friendly and walkable to the SoNo Collection, train to NYC, restaurants, waterfront & more! Feature sheet in supplements.
